name: Slide to Confirm
hint: Drag the thumb to the end. Or focus it and press Enter.
description: Drag a thumb across a track to commit. Past the threshold it snaps to the end and completes; short of it, it springs back. The label shimmers, then fades as you drag. Keyboard: Enter or right arrow.
usage: Use for irreversible actions on touch screens, especially payments and transfers. Pass `label` ("Slide to send $240"), `doneLabel` and `onConfirm`; blank labels show the neutral "Slide to confirm" / "Confirmed". If `onConfirm` returns a promise (an async function), the thumb stays at the end and busy (spinner, `busyLabel`, cannot be slid again) until it settles: resolve and it shows `doneLabel` for `resetAfter` ms, then resets by itself; reject (rethrow after showing your error) and it springs straight back so it can be slid again. If your work is tracked elsewhere, set `busy` instead. Keyboard: the thumb is a focusable slider; Enter, Space, right arrow or End confirms. Set `fullWidth` to fill a mobile layout's width (it measures its container), or give it a `width` in px. The ref is the thumb.

dataProps.description: () => void | Promise. Called once when the thumb reaches the end (drag past threshold, or Enter / Space / → / End). Return a promise to keep it busy until it settles: resolved shows doneLabel then resets after resetAfter; rejected springs back with no done state (show your own error). Returning nothing shows doneLabel straight away.
Text on the track before confirming, and the slider's accessible name. Blank shows "Slide to confirm" (the sample "Slide to pay" with `demo`).
Text shown and announced after confirming, for resetAfter ms. Blank shows "Confirmed" (the sample "Paid" with `demo`).
Text while the promise from onConfirm is pending or `busy` is true, next to a spinner on the thumb. Defaults to the done label.
Caller-owned busy state: the thumb holds at the end with a spinner, aria-busy is set and it cannot be slid again. Clearing it springs the thumb back unless a done state is showing.
Milliseconds the done state shows before it resets itself and can be slid again. It always resets; unmount it or set `disabled` if it must not be used again.
Track width in px. Ignored with fullWidth.
The track fills its container's width and measures it, so the thumb's travel follows the real width.
Not draggable or focusable; dimmed and announced as disabled.
Shows the sample labels "Slide to pay" / "Paid" where yours are blank. For the gallery; off by default.
Other attributes (id, aria-*, data-*, event handlers) go to the thumb; className and style go to the track.
The thumb (role=slider): focus it, or measure it.
